title: Velvety Rich Algerian Lemongrass Tagine
description: A rich and comforting Algerian dish featuring lemongrass stalks in a velvety emulsified sauce, perfect for a plant-based friendly meal. This dish is light and flavorful, making it a great option for any time of day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the lemongrass stalks, chickpeas, vegetable broth, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the lemongrass stalks and use an immersion blender to emulsify the sauce until smooth.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
